name: Medium- and heavy-duty vehicles and parts subject to 25% Section 232 duty (Proclamation 10984)
notes: Proclamation 10984 (October 17, 2025, 90 FR 48451, effective November 1, 2025): 25% ad valorem duty on imports of medium- and heavy-duty vehicles (MHDVs, Class 4–8) and specified MHDV parts (MHDVPs) under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962.

MHDVs covered: headings 8701, 8704, 8705, 8706, and 8709 as enumerated in subdivision (b) of U.S. note 38 to subchapter III of chapter 99 (Chapter 99 heading 9903.74.01). Excludes Class 1–3 light trucks (covered separately under Proclamation 10908 heading 9903.94.05).

MHDV parts covered: enumerated in subdivision (i) of U.S. note 38 to subchapter III (Chapter 99 heading 9903.74.08). Includes tires, glass, springs, engine parts, transmissions, axles, electrical systems, seats, and other specified components.

USMCA exemption for MHDVs: 25% applies only to the non-U.S. content value of USMCA-eligible MHDVs (9903.74.03). Requires Commerce Department certification — DO NOT apply until further CBP guidance issued.
USMCA-origin MHDV parts: exempt (9903.74.10), other than knock-down kits or parts compilations.
Vehicles 25 or more years old at date of entry: exempt (9903.74.07).
Import adjustment offset: MHDV manufacturers assembling vehicles in the U.S. may offset S232 MHDV parts duties up to 3.75% of U.S.-assembled MHDV value through October 31, 2030.
Proclamation 10984 also modified Proclamation 10925 to extend the automobile import adjustment offset (for passenger vehicles under Proclamation 10908) through April 30, 2030.
MHDVs and MHDVPs are not subject to stacked duties from S232 steel/aluminum (9903.81 headings), S232 copper (9903.78.01), or IEEPA/reciprocal tariff headings (9903.01/9903.02 series).
See buses_11_01_2025.json for buses (heading 8702) subject to 10% under this same proclamation.
HTS codes verified from CBP CSMS #66665333 (October 29, 2025) and attached Section 232 MHDV Attachment.pdf.
